0|e1112b4d96859367a93468027c9635e2ac04eb3f|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"tracing/filters: add run-time field descriptions to TRACE_EVENT_FORMAT events
This patch adds run-time field descriptions to all the event formats
exported using TRACE_EVENT_FORMAT.  It also hooks up all the tracers
that use them (i.e. the tracers in the 'ftrace subsystem') so they can
also have their output filtered by the event-filtering mechanism.
When I was testing this
column2: there were a couple of things that fooled me

column1: into thinking the filters weren't working
I'll mention them here so others don't make the same mistakes (and file
bug reports. ;-)
One is that some of the tracers trace multiple events e.g. the
sched_switch tracer uses the context_switch and wakeup events
you don't set filters on all of the traced events
from the events without filters on them can make it look like the
filtering as a whole isn't working properly
what it was asked to do - it just wasn't asked to do the right thing.
The other is that for the really high-volume tracers e.g. the function
tracer
column2: the volume of filtered events can be so high that it pushes the

column1: unfiltered events out of the ring buffer before they can be read so e.g.
cat'ing the trace file repeatedly shows either no output
awhile some output but that isn't there the next time you read the
trace
column2: which isn't what you normally expect when reading the trace file.

column1: If you read from the trace_pipe file though
they disappear.
